articles.summary: Tumult Hype 4.1.14 is a macOS compatibility update to the HTML5 animation builder for macOS. There are also a few other bug fixes. We recommend everyone upgrade, especially if you are on macOS 14 Sonoma.What’s new in Tumult Hype 4.1.14:Added Arc to the browser preview allow list
articles.title: Tumult Hype 4.1.14 Update Now Available
